npcs.name: &bGuide Mae
idle: Lovely day in Port Azure, isn't it?|The sea breeze keeps the Wingull happy.
Lost? Type /help any time.|And /warp will take you anywhere important.
See the black sharestone near the plaza?|It links every official safe zone. Red ones are built by the community!
done: Look at you, a real local now!|If you ever get lost, the black sharestone will bring you home.
Off on an adventure? Remember, /spawn brings you right back here.

npcs.name: &dNurse Joy
idle: Welcome to the Pokémon Center!|Your Pokémon are looking healthy today.
We heal Pokémon free of charge.|It's our pleasure!
done: Back again? Rest easy, your team's in good hands.|We hope to see you again!

npcs.name: &aClerk Ollie
idle: Ah, a customer! Type /shop to browse.
Got too much stuff?|Open /sell and drop it all in the box.
done: Keys, balls, dolls... we've got it all.|Come back when your wallet's full!

npcs.name: &6Crate Keeper Rin
idle: Feeling lucky?|Left-click any crate to see the odds.
Five keys merge into one of the next tier.|For a small fee, of course.
done: Every crate has a jackpot.|I've seen it happen... once.

npcs.name: &3Archivist Wren
idle: The boards update every minute.|Who will top them this month?
Catch Pokémon and beat trainers to climb the boards.
done: Your name could be up there one day.|Keep training!

npcs.name: &cEV Coach Tess
idle: EVs make a good Pokémon great.|Hold a Power item to train faster.
Each pillar marks a stat.|HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed.
done: Ready for another session?|Step through the gate and get to work!

npcs.name: &9Referee Kai
idle: Looking for a battle?|Challenge a friend right here on the court.
Fair play only on my court!
done: The court's always open.|Bring your best team!

npcs.name: &eCaptain Marlo
idle: The sea's calm today.|Perfect weather for sailing.
Ahoy! Mind the rope, it's slippery.
done: How's that Lapras treating you?|Fair winds, trainer!

steps.where: by the fountain in the Grand Plaza
lines: Oh! A new face! Welcome to Port Azure, {player}!
> Thanks! Where am I?
You're on our little island town in the middle of the sea.
I'm Mae, the town guide. I help new trainers find their feet.
The best way to learn the town is to meet everyone who runs it.
Start with Nurse Joy at the Pokémon Center. It's the big building with the red roof, north of here.
Oh, and one more thing...
Once you've met everyone, find Captain Marlo down at the docks. He has a surprise for you!

steps.where: inside the Pokémon Center (red roof, north of the plaza)
lines: Hello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center!
> Mae sent me. I'm new in town!
How wonderful! We heal Pokémon here, free of charge, any time you need.
You'll find the GTS and Wonder Trade kiosks here too, for trading with other trainers.
And please do read the server rules on the wall.
Next, you should meet Ollie at the Poké Mart. It's the building with the blue roof, to the north-west.

steps.where: inside the Poké Mart (blue roof, north-west of the plaza)
lines: Welcome to the Poké Mart! What can I get you?
> Just looking around. Nurse Joy sent me.
Ah, a newcomer! Let me tell you how things work.
Type /shop to see everything we sell: Poké Balls, healing, keys, titles, all sorts.
And if your bag's getting heavy, /sell opens a box you can drop everything into.
Rin runs the crates across the plaza. Go and try your luck!

steps.where: at the Crate Pavilion (east of the plaza)
lines: Step right up! Feeling lucky?
> What are these crates?
Each one holds prizes. Master Balls, shiny Pokémon, even legendaries!
Left-click any crate to see every reward and its exact chance.
Hold the matching key and right-click to open it.
Keys come from chores, quests, loot balls and the shop.
Wren keeps the Hall of Fame up north-east. Go see who's on top!
Ah, a visitor to the Hall of Fame.
> What are all these boards?
These boards track the town's greatest trainers.
Most Pokémon caught, most trainers beaten, and the richest trainers of all time.
The first two reset every month, so anyone can make it up here.
The world map board sits by the south road, if you want to pin your base.
Tess trains Pokémon at the EV gate on the west side of town. She can make your team stronger.

steps.where: at the EV Training gate (west side of town)
lines: Ready to get stronger?
> Wren said you could help me train.
She's right! Do you know about EVs?
Every Pokémon you defeat gives your team a little training in one stat.
Step through this gate to reach the training grounds. Each area trains a different stat.
Pair it with a Power item and you'll train twice as fast.
Kai referees battles at the Trainer Court. Go and say hi!
Halt! Who goes there?
> I'm {player}. I'm new in town.
Ha! Just kidding. Welcome!
This is the Trainer Court, where trainers settle their battles.
Challenge a friend any time. Battle fair, and shake hands after.
I think you've met just about everyone now.
Except one. Head down to the harbour and find Captain Marlo at the end of the pier.

steps.where: at the end of the harbour pier (south)
lines: Ahoy there! You must be the newcomer everyone's talking about.
> Mae said you had a surprise for me?
Ha! That I do. But first, let me look at you...
You've met the whole town. That's the mark of a real Port Azure local.
There's a friend of mine who's been waiting a long time for a trainer worth sailing with.
I think that trainer is you.
after: Her name's up to you, but she's yours now.
Her riding stats are maxed out, so she'll carry you across any sea.
Fair winds, {player}. Come visit the old captain sometime!

reward.message: Captain Marlo gave you a Lapras with maxed riding stats, and 2,500 CobbleDollars!
